nightlife.why: Viele Tanzlokale in mittelalterlichen Kellern – „Dance venues are scattered around Old Town and are often down in the medieval cellars, especially along Szewska, św. Tomasza and Szpitalna.“

food.why: Sehr große Auswahl an Lokalen – „It has been said that there are more than 300 eating and drinking establishments in the Old Town alone.“

budget.why: Privatunterkünfte kosten meist 60–90 € pro Nacht – „You can usually get a one bedroom for €60-90 a night, located in the Old Town.“

nature.why: Grüner Parkring um die Altstadt – „the ring of lightly-forested parkland, known as the Planty, that used to mark the Old City walls and moat“
